title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.13001v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (\ours{}), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbones under all seven non-empty objective combinations on five datasets with three seeds, and contrast fixed-model profiles with specialist portfolios. Rank comparisons connect imputation and prediction through numerical recovery and dependence preservation, and link generation to both through predictive utility; distributional fidelity follows different, sometimes opposing, rankings. translated_title: 一表多查询：跨生成、插补与预测的通用表格模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 生成、插补和预测查询的是同一表格分布的不同方面，但它们通常被分开评估。这使得这些任务之间共享哪些能力、其训练目标如何相互作用，以及单一模型能否同时出色完成这三项任务都尚不清楚。我们提出了一表基准，涵盖56个数据集、46个已注册方法和20个能力维度，并在统一的数据划分和明确的任务契约下进行评估。我们在对齐的支持集上比较各任务的排名，在五个数据集上以三个随机种子训练五个骨干网络的所有七种非空目标组合，并将固定模型的能力概况与专家模型组合进行对比。排名比较通过数值恢复和依赖性保持将插补与预测联系起来，并通过预测效用将生成与前两者联系起来；而分布保真度则遵循不同的、有时甚至相反的排名。目标干预实验显示出……方面的最大综合收益（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出One Table Benchmark基准，通过56个数据集、46种方法和20个能力维度的统一评估，首次系统揭示了表格数据的生成、插补与预测三类任务之间的能力关联和训练目标的相互作用，并证明单一通用模型有望同时胜任这三类任务。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces One Table Benchmark, which systematically evaluates generalist tabular models across generation, imputation, and prediction using 56 datasets, 46 methods, and 20 capability axes, revealing how these tasks share capabilities, how their training objectives interact, and whether a single model can excel at all three.
